Neha — thanks for flagging. A few procurement/controls notes:

1) Our baseline policy requires a PO for all vendor spend to keep auditability and match invoices. That said, for small recurring SaaS connectors we have a documented provisional process (limited-scope, timebox) that procurement can approve if conditions are met.

2) Required items for provisional no-PO approval:
   - Completed onboarding form (we have it)
   - Vendor tax form / W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent
   - Completed ACH/EFT banking form or payment setup guide
   - Signed SOW or subscription terms (PDF)
   - Clear invoicing instructions (where invoice will be sent) and account code to use

3) Controls: provisional window default = 60 days; finance will route payments through a billing mailbox. After 60 days vendor must be fully onboarded into AP and POs issued for future spend, otherwise we suspend billing.

4) If vendor insists on Net 30 and we accept provisional no-PO, finance will require a documented approval (email thread) from FP&A lead. Alternatively, vendor can accept Net 15 in the provisional window to reduce risk.

Can you ask Alex for the W-9 and ACH form, and confirm they can accept the provisional terms? I can draft the internal approval stub for legal/FP&A.

-Rishi
